findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Finsupp/Weight.lean:82-83 defines `weight w := (Finsupp.linearCombination R w).toAddMonoidHom`; there is no lemma relating `weight` to `linearCombination`, so these steps close only by unfolding.
findings.fix: Either state the hypotheses and conclusions with `Finsupp.weight a`, matching `IsWeightedHomogeneous`/`weightedHomogeneousComponent`, or add an explicit `Finsupp.weight a w = Finsupp.linearCombination ℕ a w` lemma and rewrite with it instead of relying on `rfl`/unification.
findings.issue: Undocumented defeq `Finsupp.weight a w ≡ Finsupp.linearCombination ℕ a w`. In `weightedHomogeneousComponent_monomial_sub_monomial_sub`: `isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial _ _ _ rfl`, `huv.symm`, and `absurd (congrArg m.toSyn hwd) (hQ w hw).ne`. In `exists_mem_span_support_lt`: `isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial a w _ rfl`, `(huv j).symm` in `hβ`, and `weightedHomogeneousComponent_ne _ (Ne.symm hwd)` in `hcomp`. In `exists_mem_span_degree_aeval_eq` `hP'`: the case split is on `Finsupp.weight (m.degree ∘ c) w = d` but `hwd (m.toSyn.injective h)` supplies an equation about `A w`.

findings.evidence: `rw [weightedHomogeneousComponent_apply, map_sum, ...]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ...` with the goal filtered by `Finsupp.linearCombination ℕ a u = d`.
findings.fix: State the right-hand side with `Finsupp.weight a u = d`, or rewrite through an explicit weight/linearCombination lemma.
findings.issue: `Finset.sum_congr rfl` equates the filter `weight a u = d` from `weightedHomogeneousComponent_apply` with the stated filter `linearCombination ℕ a u = d` by definitional unfolding only.

findings.evidence: `hJ := ... Submodule.span_induction ... rw [map_sub, hQ, sub_self]` versus `(Ideal.span_le.2 ...) ... rw [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hQ, sub_self]`.
findings.fix: Factor out one lemma, e.g. `span_sub_le_ker_aeval : Ideal.span (range F) ≤ RingHom.ker (aeval c)` proved via `Ideal.span_le`, and use it in both places.
findings.issue: `hJ` in `exists_mem_span_degree_aeval_eq` re-proves by a manual `Submodule.span_induction` the inclusion span(β j - Q j) ≤ ker (aeval c); `ker_aeval_eq_span_sub` then proves the same inclusion again via `Ideal.span_le`.

findings.evidence: The `rcases Finset.mem_union.1 (support_add hw)` / `coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent` / `by_cases hwd` block does not depend on `c`, `Q` or `J`.
findings.fix: Extract it as a lemma about `weightedHomogeneousComponent` and the support bound, and call it from the descent step.
findings.issue: The `hP'` block of `exists_mem_span_degree_aeval_eq` proves a general fact inline: if every exponent of `P` has `A`-degree ≼ d, then every exponent of `P - weightedHomogeneousComponent a d P` has `A`-degree ≺ d. Keeping it inline also pushes the proof past 50 lines.

summary: Statements use `Finsupp.linearCombination ℕ a` while the Mathlib weighted-homogeneous API uses `Finsupp.weight a`, and the proofs move between the two only by undocumented definitional unfolding. A span-to-kernel fact is also proved twice, and a reusable support bound is buried inline.
